Apotheosis (Quest)#000.src: Head to {p} and find your friends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#001.src: Fight through {p} and find your friends.

Apotheosis (Quest)#002.src: Ha. Your bow control is sloppy, "captain."
Apotheosis (Quest)#002.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#006.src: Thanks for the support, {u}! Not sure how much longer I could've held out on my own.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.dst: 도와줘서 고마워, {u}! 혼자서는 얼마나 더 버틸 수 있었을지 모르겠어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#007.src: We were about to regroup with the Canopy, but Cileon spotted soldiers approaching through the hotel windows.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.dst: Canopy랑 다시 합류하려던 참에, Cileon이 호텔 창문 너머로 병사들이 오는 걸 봤어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#008.src: They've stormed the plaza, and probably the rest of the city by now... I think they've rounded up all the citizens at the festival grounds.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.dst: 놈들이 광장을 쳐들어왔고, 지금쯤 도시 전체를 장악했을 거야... 시민들을 전부 축제장에 몰아넣은 것 같아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#009.src: We all got split up in the commotion - the others are probably fighting their own battles! Come on, we need to get moving!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.dst: 난리통에 다들 흩어졌어. 다른 애들도 각자 싸우고 있을 거야! 어서, 움직여야 해!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#011.src: Find the rest of your friends in {p}.

Apotheosis (Quest)#013.src: Phew... th...that was close. {u}, it's g- good to see you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.dst: 휴... 아, 아슬아슬했어. {u}, 다, 다시 봐서 반가워.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#014.src: Where are the others? Have you seen them?
Apotheosis (Quest)#014.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#015.src: I saw Cileon u- up ahead! But I l- lo- lost sight of Sui a while ago...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.dst: Cileon은 저, 저 앞에서 봤어! 근데 Sui는 좀 전에 노, 놓쳤어...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#016.src: Then what are we waiting for?! Let's get moving!
Apotheosis (Quest)#016.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#018.src: ...{u}, if y...you're here, then... the Queen...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#018.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#019.src: Worry about our friends first, Queen second! Come one, move move move!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.dst: 친구들 먼저 걱정하고, 여왕은 그다음이야! 어서, 가자 가자 가자!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#024.src: Th...that was awesome, Cileon!! Could you t- te- teach me some of your techni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.dst: 대, 대단했어, Cileon!! 나한테도 기, 기술 좀 가르쳐 줄 수-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#025.src: ZEPH! There's no TIME!! Cileon, have you seen Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.dst: ZEPH! 그럴 시간 없어!! Cileon, Sui 봤어?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#033.src: Sui, that was i- in- incredible!! But, using that much m...magic... be careful not to use up all of your st- strength...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.dst: Sui, 굉장했어!! 그래도 마, 마법을 그렇게 많이 쓰면... 힘을 다 쓰, 쓰지 않게 조심해...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#034.src: ...it's fine, Zeph. It doesn't drain me to use, anymore. I can just... pull on the strands.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.dst: ...괜찮아, Zeph. 이제는 써도 기운이 안 빠져. 그냥... 가닥을 당기기만 하면 돼.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#036.src: R- ri- right... the festival speech. Should we try to l...listen in on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.dst: 마, 맞다... 축제 연설. 우리 가서 드, 들어 볼까?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#037.src: What?! No! We're all safe, so let's get out of here and regroup with the rest of the Canopy! Doing anything else is way too risky-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.dst: 뭐?! 안 돼! 다들 무사하니까 여기서 빠져나가서 Canopy 사람들이랑 합류하자! 다른 짓은 너무 위험해-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#038.src: No. I'm... I'm done running away. We're going in.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.dst: 아니. 난... 이제 도망치는 건 그만할래. 들어가자.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#040.src: She's responsible for everything that has happened to us. I'm not going to just... let her get away when she's RIGHT THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.dst: 우리한테 일어난 일은 전부 그 여자 탓이야. 바로 저기 있는데 그냥... 놓아줄 순 없어!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#041.src: She's going to pay for all of it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#041.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#042.src: S- Sui... you don't h- have to do it alone.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.dst: S, Sui... 혼, 혼자 할 필요는 없어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#043.src: ...fine. Fine! Let's do it, then! Let's go... face the Queen.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.dst: ...좋아. 좋다고! 그럼 해 보자! 가서... 여왕이랑 맞서자.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#044.src: Make your way to the festival grounds at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#048.src: ...th- this was a bad idea. We n...need to get out of-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.dst: ...이, 이건 나쁜 생각이었어. 여기서 빠, 빠져나가-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#049.src: People of the {p}! I deeply apologize for the disruption to your routines. You must be confused, afraid.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.dst: {p}의 백성들이여! 일상을 방해하게 되어 깊이 사과하노라. 혼란스럽고, 두렵겠지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#050.src: This festival is a time for joy, for celebration! But there are those within your midst who reject this notion. They aim to bring destruction, chaos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.dst: 이 축제는 기쁨과 경축의 시간이다! 허나 너희 가운데 이를 거부하는 자들이 있다. 그들은 파괴와 혼돈을 노리고 있다!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#051.src: Indeed... a plot to twist our province's ideals, to destroy our very way of life! The perpetrators lurking in your city, feigning innocence... what a disgrace.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.dst: 그렇다... 우리 지방의 이상을 비틀고, 우리 삶의 방식을 무너뜨리려는 음모! 너희 도시에 숨어 무고한 척하는 범인들... 참으로 수치로다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#052.src: It was your very own Sovereign, Majin Thalas, whose quick thinking brought down the terrorists' plot! The Wings, the Constables, the Local Guard, all have mobilized to capture the perpetrators.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.dst: 테러리스트의 음모를 기민하게 막아 낸 것은 바로 너희의 군주, Majin Thalas였다! 날개 기사단, 치안대, 지역 경비대가 모두 범인 체포에 나섰다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#053.src: Soon, we shall have them chained before you. Soon, you shall see the faces of this blight, this infection in the veins of our province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.dst: 곧 그들을 사슬에 묶어 너희 앞에 세우리라. 곧 이 역병의 얼굴을, 우리 지방의 혈관에 퍼진 이 감염을 보게 되리라.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#054.src: And soon, we shall cut. It. Out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#055.src: Listen to Her Majesty and her Sovereigns.

Apotheosis (Quest)#058.src: And so it would seem my Sovereigns have once again failed to perform what should be a very simple task.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.dst: 그렇다면 내 군주들이 또다시 아주 간단한 일조차 해내지 못한 모양이구나.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#059.src: Sovereign Thalas, what, precisely, is it you have been teaching these soldiers of yours?! Because there should be no reason for them to have FAILED to capture these CHILDREN!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.dst: Thalas 군주, 대체 네 병사들에게 무엇을 가르친 것이냐?! 이 어린애들을 붙잡는 데 실패할 이유가 전혀 없거늘!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#060.src: I told you we should've taken the direct solution! More dead soldiers, more of our people subtracted out, for nothing!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.dst: 직접적인 해법을 택하자고 했잖소! 병사만 더 죽고, 우리 백성만 더 빼기 됐지, 얻은 건 없소!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#061.src: Hm! Now, let us be clear, the soldiers are-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.dst: 흠! 자, 분명히 해 두자면, 병사들은-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#062.src: Oh, I do not care. Save your excuses.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#063.src: I have given you more than enough chances to realise the weight of what it is we do!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.dst: 우리가 하는 일의 무게를 깨달을 기회를 이미 충분히 넘치도록 주었거늘!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#064.src: You...you have proven very hard to pin down, it would seem. No matter the circumstances, you have a knack for slipping through the cracks...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.dst: 너... 너는 참으로 붙잡기 어려운 자로구나. 어떤 상황에서든 틈새로 빠져나가는 재주가 있어...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#065.src: It would be oh so simple to blame you for all you have enacted... but the truth is, you were merely the catalyst. The seeds of this rebellion were planted long, long before you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.dst: 네가 저지른 모든 일을 네 탓으로 돌리기는 참 쉽겠지... 허나 사실 너는 촉매였을 뿐. 이 반란의 씨앗은 너보다 훨씬, 훨씬 전에 뿌려졌다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#066.src: Oh, the {p}... over these centuries, its beauty has never faded. The vibrant colors, the warm breeze of the changing seasons...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.dst: 오, {p}... 수백 년이 지나도 그 아름다움은 바래지 않았구나. 선명한 색채, 계절이 바뀔 때의 따스한 바람...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#067.src: What a shame, then, that beneath the cover of the leaves, there lurk countless cowering pests. And no matter how hard I try, I cannot seem to wash them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.dst: 그러니 안타깝구나. 나뭇잎 그늘 아래 수없이 많은 해충이 웅크리고 있으니. 아무리 애써도 씻어 낼 수가 없어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#068.src: Fell the perceived source of their strength, cut the branches and burn the leaves, the fruit that emboldens their acts - and still, they persist!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.dst: 그들이 믿는 힘의 원천을 베어 넘기고, 가지를 치고 잎을 태우고, 대담하게 만드는 열매도 없앴다. 그런데도 버틴다!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#069.src: Bury their monuments, erase their gods - and still, and STILL, they cling to ideals of love, of family! And still, and still, and still, they persist.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.dst: 기념비를 묻고, 신들을 지웠다. 그런데도, 그런데도 사랑과 가족이라는 이상에 매달린다! 그런데도, 그런데도, 버틴다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#070.src: Washing it all away had shown results... for a time. But even growing forth from a blank slate, even with no ties to what came before - still, still, STILL THEY PERSIST!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.dst: 모든 걸 씻어 내자 효과가 있었다... 한동안은. 허나 백지에서 다시 자라나도, 과거와 아무 연이 없어도, 그런데도, 그런데도, 그런데도 버틴다!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#071.src: There is a rot in the heart of that forest. I see that now. Perhaps, I had allowed my fondness for the region to blind me... but no more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.dst: 그 숲의 중심이 썩어 있다. 이제야 보이는구나. 그 지역에 대한 애정에 눈이 멀었던 모양이다... 허나 이제는 아니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#072.src: And so, as once we saw out the New Age, so again shall we wash away these pests. That accursed forest will drown, and the rot buried deep will be excised once more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.dst: 그러니 새 시대를 떠나보냈던 그때처럼, 이 해충들을 다시 씻어 내리라. 저주받은 숲은 물에 잠기고, 깊이 묻힌 썩은 부분은 다시 한번 도려내질 것이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#074.src: W-With respect, that is not a viable angle! The Resistance is such a small percentage of the overall population, they're practically a rounding error!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.dst: 소, 송구하오나, 그건 성립하지 않는 해법입니다! 저항군은 전체 인구에서 극히 작은 비율, 사실상 반올림 오차입니다!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#075.src: You can't divide out a quarter of our province's people, a-and just as much infrastructure, just to solve for a subset of rogue integers!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.dst: 불량 정수 몇 개를 풀자고, 지방 인구의 4분의 1과 그만큼의 기반 시설을 나눠 없앨 수는 없습니다!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#076.src: Learn when to keep your mouth shut, would you, Nasin?! We are standing before the public! This is not the time to raise such grievances-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.dst: 입 다물 때를 좀 배우시지, Nasin?! 백성들 앞이오! 그런 불만을 꺼낼 때가 아니-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#077.src: That didn't stop you interrupting my sequence and openly denigrating the recruits at the tournament to fulfill your petty factoring grudge!! You have no excuses!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.dst: 그래 놓고 당신은 쪼잔한 앙금을 풀자고 내 수열을 끊고 대회에서 신병들을 대놓고 깎아내렸잖소!! 변명할 여지도 없소!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#078.src: We- We have been wasting our numbers at every point. When did our vector shift to something so shortsighted? When did we lose sight of our nontrivial solution?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.dst: 우, 우린 매번 숫자를 낭비해 왔소. 언제부터 우리 벡터가 이리 근시안적으로 틀어졌소? 언제 자명하지 않은 해를 놓쳤단 말이오?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#079.src: You're both plugged into a destructive sequence! I can't enable these irrationalities!! I refuse to be a variable in this cyclical, downwards spiral!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.dst: 둘 다 파괴적인 수열에 꽂혀 있소! 이런 무리수는 용납 못 하오!! 이 순환 하강 나선의 변수가 되길 거부하겠소!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#080.src: Take care with what you do next, Zhiraok Nasin. If you turn away now, you will forsake your position and forfeit your life.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.dst: 다음 행동을 신중히 고르거라, Zhiraok Nasin. 지금 등을 돌리면 지위도 목숨도 잃게 될 것이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#083.src: If this is what honor is supposed to feel like, I don't want it anymore.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.dst: 이게 명예라는 거라면, 이제 필요 없습니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#084.src: My loyalty is to the people. If yours isn't, then our vectors no longer converge. I'm subtracting my pact to you myself.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.dst: 제 충성은 백성을 향합니다. 당신은 아니라면, 우리 벡터는 더는 수렴하지 않습니다. 당신과의 서약은 제 손으로 빼겠습니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#085.src: Gotta evacuate, contact Xao, the commanders, get everyone to higher ground, find where the helix S-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.dst: 대피시키고, Xao와 지휘관들에게 연락하고, 모두 고지대로 옮기고, 나선 S가 어디인지 찾-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#086.src: Hmph! You Majesty, if you would allow it, I would gladly put his head on a stick for you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.dst: 흥! 폐하, 허락해 주신다면 기꺼이 저자의 목을 장대에 꽂아 드리겠습니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#087.src: Firstly, Sovereign Thalas, I would have you clean up your mess. Execute the terrorists.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.dst: 우선, Thalas 군주, 네가 벌인 일부터 수습하거라. 테러리스트들을 처형해라.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#088.src: ...and once you are done, you have my approval to hunt down ex-Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.dst: ...그리고 끝나면, 전 군주 Zhiraok Nasin을 추적하는 것을 허락하마.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#089.src: While you are at it, eliminate that entire House. They have disappointed me far too many times, and I have granted them far too many chances.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.dst: 하는 김에 그 가문 전체를 제거해라. 날 너무 여러 번 실망시켰고, 기회도 너무 많이 주었다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#090.src: Aha! Gladly. As you wish, Your Majesty. It will be done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.dst: 아하! 기꺼이. 분부대로 하겠습니다, 폐하. 반드시 해내지요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#091.src: Sovereign Tasim. You will be coming with me to the dam.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.dst: Tasim 군주. 너는 나와 함께 댐으로 간다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#094.src: Ahhh... Finally! I'd been awaiting the day I'd get the chance to wipe you rats off the face of the planet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.dst: 아아... 드디어! 너희 쥐새끼들을 이 땅에서 쓸어버릴 날만 기다렸지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#095.src: But before we begin, I'm an honourable man, so I'll grant you this opportunity! Any last words for the crowd?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.dst: 허나 시작하기 전에, 난 명예를 아는 사람이니 기회를 주마! 관중에게 남길 유언은?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#096.src: Ahahahaha! Did you, now? That the great Sovereign Majin would fall to a simple group of insurgents... What a laughably fanciful tale!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.dst: 아하하하하! 그렇단 말이지? 위대한 Majin 군주가 반란군 나부랭이에게 쓰러진다니... 이 얼마나 우스운 공상인가!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#097.src: My goodness, what a statement! You truly believe so? That you of all people stand a chance against my might?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.dst: 세상에, 대단한 발언이군! 정말 그렇게 믿나? 하필 네가 내 힘에 맞설 수 있다고?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#098.src: Oh, how dreadfully dull. If you are going to be so dramatic, use a better line, would you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#098.dst: 오, 지독히도 따분하군. 그렇게 극적으로 굴 거면 대사라도 좀 나은 걸로 하지 그래?
Apotheosis (Quest)#098.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#099.src: Ha! As if. Half those tabloids are filled with naught but meaningless gossip! Though, I do have an appreciation for the Majin Monthly. It's quite the interesting read, you know!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.dst: 하! 퍽이나. 그 가십지들 절반은 쓸데없는 뒷소문뿐이야! 그래도 Majin 월간지는 좀 좋아하지. 꽤 흥미로운 읽을거리라고!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#100.src: Hm... But I'm afraid only one of you is worthy of facing me in combat. As for the rest of you pitiful worms...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.dst: 흠... 하지만 나와 겨룰 자격이 있는 건 너희 중 하나뿐이로군. 나머지 가련한 벌레들은...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#102.src: Ah ah ah! Keep your eyes on what's important, mmn?
Apotheosis (Quest)#102.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#103.src: You should feel honoured! Very few are given the privilege of dying to my blade. I'd tell you to write about it in your memoirs, but...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.dst: 영광으로 알아라! 내 칼에 죽는 특권을 누리는 자는 극소수지. 회고록에 써 두라고 하고 싶지만...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#104.src: Well, I don't imagine you'll have the chance. NOW -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.dst: 뭐, 그럴 기회는 없을 테니. 자 -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#105.src: Defeat Majin. To return to the fight, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#106.src: Welcome to my domain of the starry night, dear guest! Quite the stunning view, is it not?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.dst: 별이 빛나는 밤의 내 영역에 온 걸 환영하네, 손님! 꽤 멋진 광경이지 않나?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#107.src: By all means - take your time, take it all in, every little detail! Allow that feeling to sink in - your sheer insignificance in the face of the vastness of the cosmos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.dst: 얼마든지 - 천천히, 하나하나 빠짐없이 감상하게! 그 느낌을 음미해 봐 - 광대한 우주 앞에서 너란 존재가 얼마나 하찮은지!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#108.src: Ah... Her Majesty and the Spymaster, they held interest in you once. Looking upon you now, I simply cannot fathom why.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.dst: 아... 여왕 폐하와 첩보대장이 한때 너에게 관심을 가졌었지. 지금 보니 도무지 이유를 모르겠군.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#109.src: But I suppose it matters not! You have certainly cut that strand of interest with all your assorted antics, haven't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.dst: 뭐, 상관없겠지! 온갖 소동을 피워서 그 관심의 끈을 스스로 끊어 버렸으니, 안 그래?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#110.src: Well! If you must die, be glad it was to my blade! LET THE SHOW BEGIN!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.dst: 자! 어차피 죽을 거라면 내 칼에 죽는 걸 기뻐해라! 쇼를 시작하지!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#111.src: Flooding the whole forest... There's- That can't be, th-there's no way...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.dst: 숲 전체를 물에 잠기게... 그건- 말도 안 돼, 그, 그럴 리가...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#112.src: I certainly hope you've learned your lesson, Rose! This is what happens! Loose nails get hammered down!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.dst: 이번에 교훈 좀 얻었길 바라, Rose! 이렇게 되는 거라고! 모난 돌이 정 맞는 거야!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#114.src: This is all happening because a certain SOMEONE incited violence against the crown! In the papers no less, where we do our work!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.dst: 이게 다 어떤 '누구'가 왕실에 대한 폭력을 선동해서잖아! 그것도 우리가 일하는 신문에서!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#115.src: Risky, dangerous, all of it- and now look where we are! Public executions! We might not even be allowed to publish after this!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.dst: 위험하고, 무모하고, 전부 다- 그래서 지금 꼴을 봐! 공개 처형이라고! 이 일 후엔 발행도 못 하게 될지 몰라!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#116.src: ...there are...HOW many people in danger right now, a-and all you can think to do is-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.dst: ...지금 위험에 처한 사람이... '몇 명'인데, 네, 네가 생각하는 건 고작-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#118.src: How can you be so monumentally stupid?! At least they TRIED! At least they SHOWED UP! They followed through!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.dst: 어떻게 그렇게 엄청나게 멍청할 수가 있어?! 적어도 그 사람들은 '시도'했어! '나서기'라도 했다고! 끝까지 해냈어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#119.src: The first hope I've seen in years, and you throw petty insults at them?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.dst: 몇 년 만에 처음 본 희망인데, 거기다 대고 치졸한 욕이나 해?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#120.src: Ergh...where did you learn to hit?! Can you really only rely on that to make your point?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.dst: 윽...주먹은 어디서 배웠어?! 주장을 펼칠 방법이 그것밖에 없니?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#121.src: Oh, grow UP already!! Think of something useful to do, instead of looking at the people who are doing anything more than sitting on their asses and going "how uncivilized!"
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.dst: 철 좀 들어!! 엉덩이 붙이고 앉아서 '야만스럽기도 하지!' 하는 대신, 뭐라도 하는 사람들 보면서 쓸모 있는 일이나 생각해!
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#122.src: Hey, language! And besides, it's not as if that insurgent has any chance against-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.dst: 야, 말 조심해! 게다가 그 반란분자가 이길 가능성이라곤-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#126.src: ...The Sovereign...is dead!! The Resistance is triumphant!! Can't you see?! They were right!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.dst: ...군주가...죽었어!! 저항군이 이겼어!! 안 보여?! 그 사람들이 옳았어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#127.src: We need to help them! This might be our only chance, we can't let it slip away from us!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.dst: 도와야 해! 이게 유일한 기회일지도 몰라, 놓칠 수 없어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#133.src: MAJIN'S DEAD, WHAT CAN THEY DO NOW?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.dst: MAJIN이 죽었어, 이제 놈들이 뭘 하겠어?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Apotheosis (Quest)#134.src: You! You really did it!! People are...they're doing something!! It worked, I can't believe it worked!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.dst: 당신! 정말 해냈어!! 사람들이...움직이고 있어!! 먹혔어, 믿기지 않아!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#135.src: I'm going with them! We have to keep up the momentum, m-maybe I can direct them! You do whatever you have to- I trust you! We'll make it!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.dst: 난 저 사람들이랑 갈래! 기세를 이어 가야 해, 어, 어쩌면 내가 이끌 수도 있고! 당신은 할 일을 해- 믿을게! 우린 해낼 거야!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#137.dst: {u}!! 사, 살아 있구나!! 그럼 그 말은...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#137.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#139.src: Good. That's one less Sovereign to worry about...
Apotheosis (Quest)#139.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#141.src: She... she really threatened to flood the {p}... didn't she...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.dst: 그 여자... 정말로 {p}을(를) 물에 잠기게 하겠다고 한 거지...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#142.src: I- I- I can't believe it... all be- because we won't b...back down?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.dst: 미, 미, 믿을 수가 없어... 전부 우, 우리가 무, 물러서지 않아서?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#143.src: Well, I can. Just like the New Age... ugh, was THAT her too?! We're unprepared, outmatched... how are we meant to-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.dst: 난 믿겨. 새 시대 때처럼... 윽, 그것도 그 여자 짓이었어?! 준비도 안 됐고, 상대도 안 되는데... 어떻게-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#144.src: It doesn't matter! We- we have to stop her! We can't just... let her kill all those people!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.dst: 상관없어! 우, 우린 막아야 해! 그 사람들을 다... 죽게 내버려 둘 순 없어!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#145.src: ...I hate it, but you're right. Come on, let's-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.dst: ...인정하기 싫지만 네 말이 맞아. 가자, 우리-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#146.src: Phew- you're all still standing strong!! Good, good... I- phew- I was getting worried!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.dst: 휴- 다들 아직 멀쩡하군요!! 좋아요, 좋아... 저- 휴- 걱정하던 참이었어요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#147.src: R...Rurie? What are you doing h- here?
Apotheosis (Quest)#147.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#148.src: Ah! One moment, just, ha, allow me to catch my breath- let me tell you, those speed talismans are handy but they really leave you winded-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.dst: 아! 잠깐, 하, 숨 좀 돌리고요- 말해 두지만, 그 신속 호부가 편하긴 한데 숨이 턱까지 차요-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#149.src: ...ohohohoho, do my eyes decieve me?! I'd heard the townsfolk talking but I could hardly believe it- is it really true? Has the Sovereign Thalas truly been felled?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.dst: ...오호호호, 내 눈을 의심해야 하나요?! 마을 사람들 얘길 듣고도 못 믿었는데- 정말이에요? Thalas 군주가 정말 쓰러졌어요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#152.src: Good! Great, even! Got what he deserved, in the end!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.dst: 좋아요! 아니, 최고예요! 결국 받을 벌을 받았네요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#153.src: Hm? No, it's perfectly normal. If you had the vendetta I had, then, well! You would react likewise, I'm certain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#153.dst: 네? 아뇨, 지극히 정상이에요. 나만큼 원한이 있었다면, 뭐! 당신도 분명 똑같이 반응했을걸요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#153.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#154.src: Hm? No, it's perfectly normal. If you had the vendetta I had, then, well! You would react likewise, I'm certain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#154.dst: 네? 아뇨, 지극히 정상이에요. 나만큼 원한이 있었다면, 뭐! 당신도 분명 똑같이 반응했을걸요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#154.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#155.src: Dead! Dead! He's dead, and I'm not, and I win! Hahahahaha!
Apotheosis (Quest)#155.dst: 죽었다! 죽었어! 그자는 죽고 난 살았으니, 내가 이겼어요! 하하하하하!
Apotheosis (Quest)#155.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#157.src: Problems! Right! Right right right right right!! That's why I'm here, after all- haha, apologies, got distracted a moment...
Apotheosis (Quest)#157.dst: 문제! 맞아요! 맞아 맞아 맞아 맞아 맞아!! 그 때문에 온 거죠- 하하, 미안해요, 잠깐 딴생각을...
Apotheosis (Quest)#157.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#158.src: It seems the crown's finally recovered from the shock, and attacks on the safe zone have increased in strength and frequency!
Apotheosis (Quest)#158.dst: 왕실이 드디어 충격에서 벗어났는지, 안전 구역에 대한 공격이 더 강하고 잦아졌어요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#158.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#159.src: She sent me to... well, to check and see if you're alive, firstly - but also to bring whoever I can back to support the defense effort!
Apotheosis (Quest)#159.dst: 그분이 저를 보냈어요... 음, 우선 여러분이 살아 있는지 확인하라고요. 그리고 데려갈 수 있는 사람은 다 데려와 방어를 도우라고요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#159.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#160.src: We have issues here too, Rurie. The Queen has just publicly announced she's going to FLOOD the {p}!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#160.dst: 여기도 문제가 있어, Rurie. 여왕이 방금 {p}을(를) '물에 잠기게' 하겠다고 공개 선언했어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#160.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#161.src: Oh! Oh, dear! That isn't good at all! We've truly driven her far enough to warrant such an act?
Apotheosis (Quest)#161.dst: 오! 이런, 세상에! 그건 전혀 좋지 않네요! 우리가 정말 그런 짓을 할 만큼 그 여자를 몰아붙였단 말이에요?
Apotheosis (Quest)#161.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#162.src: Rurie, I'll g- go with you. I... I need to m...make sure Yuman's safe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#162.dst: Rurie, 나, 나도 같이 갈게. 나... Yuman이 무사한지 화, 확인해야 해.
Apotheosis (Quest)#162.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#164.src: Rex, Sui, {u}... I- I want to h...help you, but-
Apotheosis (Quest)#164.dst: Rex, Sui, {u}... 나, 나도 도, 돕고 싶은데-
Apotheosis (Quest)#164.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#165.src: Hey, Zeph, it's alright. Make sure there's a resistance still standing for us to rejoin when it's all over, alright?
Apotheosis (Quest)#165.dst: 야, Zeph, 괜찮아. 다 끝나면 우리가 돌아갈 저항군이 남아 있게만 해 줘, 알았지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#165.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#167.src: Y- you guys too! Let's reunite wh...when this is all over, alright?
Apotheosis (Quest)#167.dst: 너, 너희도! 다 끝, 끝나면 다시 만나자, 알았지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#167.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#168.src: Then it's settled! Good luck, you three! Go show the Queen what you've got!
Apotheosis (Quest)#168.dst: 그럼 결정됐네요! 행운을 빌어요, 셋 다! 가서 여왕에게 실력을 보여 줘요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#168.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#169.src: Head to the dam and stop the Queen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#171.src: Necessary? Very little ever is. But it will prove a point.
Apotheosis (Quest)#171.dst: 필요? 필요한 일은 거의 없지. 허나 본보기는 될 것이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#171.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#172.src: Really. Thousands of lives... to prove a point.
Apotheosis (Quest)#172.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#173.src: You understand the stakes of the greater task, yes? If that end is not averted, they die regardless. Them, and everyone else.
Apotheosis (Quest)#173.dst: 더 큰 과업이 무엇을 걸고 있는지 알지 않느냐? 그 결말을 막지 못하면 그들은 어차피 죽는다. 그들도, 다른 모두도.
Apotheosis (Quest)#173.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#174.src: And without order here, we will lack the focus to see it through. So, see it as a necessary evil. Nothing more, nothing less.
Apotheosis (Quest)#174.dst: 그리고 여기 질서가 없으면 끝까지 해낼 집중력도 잃는다. 그러니 필요악으로 여겨라. 그 이상도 이하도 아니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#174.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#176.src: She will come around. She always does, in the end.
Apotheosis (Quest)#176.dst: 마음을 돌릴 게다. 결국엔 늘 그러니.
Apotheosis (Quest)#176.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#178.src: I don't like this. There are better opt-
Apotheosis (Quest)#178.dst: 마음에 안 듭니다. 더 나은 방법이-
Apotheosis (Quest)#178.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#179.src: You do not have to like it, Sovereign. But if you wish to make change for the world, you will have to see it through.
Apotheosis (Quest)#179.dst: 마음에 들 필요는 없다, 군주. 허나 세상을 바꾸고 싶다면 끝까지 해내야 한다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#179.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#182.src: We won't let you go through with this!
Apotheosis (Quest)#182.dst: 이런 짓은 절대 못 하게 할 거야!

Apotheosis (Quest)#422.src: But you won't kill me. So I guess I have to keep going... don't I?
Apotheosis (Quest)#422.dst: 그래도 넌 날 죽이지 않겠지. 그럼 계속 살아가야 하는 거네... 그렇지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#422.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#425.src: Head to the gates of Aelumia at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#427.src: Make sure everyone is okay in the safe zone at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#428.src: ...and now all chaos has broken loose in the citadel, so some numbers truly would go a long way towards-
Apotheosis (Quest)#428.dst: ...그리고 지금 성채는 완전히 아수라장이니, 인원이 조금만 더 있어도 정말 큰 도움이-
Apotheosis (Quest)#428.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#429.src: Yes, Rurie, I know. Hold for just one minute, would you?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#429.dst: 네, Rurie, 알아요. 딱 1분만 기다려 줄래요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#429.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#430.src: Fine, fine. Yes, please, take your time! It's not as though the world is ending or anything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#430.dst: 좋아요, 좋아. 네, 제발, 천천히 하세요! 세상이 끝나는 것도 아닌데 뭐!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#430.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#432.src: Hm? {u}!! You're alive, that's a relief - if you wouldn't mind answering, what the - and excuse the language - HELL is going on?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#432.dst: 네? {u}!! 살아 있다니 다행이에요 - 괜찮다면 대답 좀 해 줄래요, 말이 험해서 미안하지만 - 대체 무슨 '빌어먹을' 일이 벌어진 거예요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#432.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#433.src: The SKY ITSELF has cracked open, there's RED LIGHTNING up there - and I have seen storms before, that is not normal - everything is a MESS! Explain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#433.dst: '하늘 자체'가 갈라졌고, 저 위에 '붉은 번개'가 쳐요 - 폭풍은 봤지만 저건 정상이 아니에요 - 전부 '엉망'이라고요! 설명해 봐요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#433.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#436.src: And just when I thought we had reached the limit on fanciful tales... goodness. And you singlehandedly defeated her in combat?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#436.dst: 이제 공상 같은 얘기는 한계에 달한 줄 알았는데... 세상에. 그리고 혼자서 그 여자를 전투로 쓰러뜨렸다고요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#436.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#438.src: Yes, Cileon, I suppose I shouldn't be surprised after that display... and yet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#438.dst: 그래요, Cileon, 그걸 보고 나서 놀라면 안 되겠죠... 그래도요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#438.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#439.src: But back to the topic at hand - she is responsible for all of this?! This is... beyond my means to process.
Apotheosis (Quest)#439.dst: 하지만 본론으로 돌아가서 - 이 모든 게 그 여자 짓이라고요?! 이건... 제 머리로는 감당이 안 돼요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#439.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#440.src: A corrupt and oppressive governmental structure - that, I can plan around. For that, I at least have some inkling as to how to fight against it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#440.dst: 부패하고 억압적인 정부 구조 - 그건 대비할 수 있어요. 그런 건 적어도 어떻게 싸워야 할지 감이라도 있죠.
Apotheosis (Quest)#440.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#441.src: But this? For this, I have nothing. What is one even supposed to do about-
Apotheosis (Quest)#441.dst: 하지만 이건? 이건 아무 수가 없어요. 대체 이런 걸 어떻게-
Apotheosis (Quest)#441.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#442.src: Ah! There we are! Twelve injured allies, five casualties, one bout of madness... talisman stockpiles mostly burned through - only two remaining, we'll have to produce more...
Apotheosis (Quest)#442.dst: 아! 됐다! 부상 열둘, 사망 다섯, 광증 하나... 호부 비축분은 거의 다 썼고 - 둘 남았으니 더 만들어야겠고...
Apotheosis (Quest)#442.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#443.src: Food rations will hold for another three and a half days, so we'll need to send a supply run tomorrow... at least armor and weapon supplies are still in surp-
Apotheosis (Quest)#443.dst: 식량 배급은 사흘 반 더 버티니 내일 보급대를 보내야 하고... 그래도 갑옷과 무기 보급은 아직 넉넉-
Apotheosis (Quest)#443.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#444.src: Oh. {u}, you're here. Good to see you're still standing. What are we talking about?
Apotheosis (Quest)#444.dst: 아. {u}, 왔군요. 아직 멀쩡해서 다행이에요. 무슨 얘기 중이었죠?
Apotheosis (Quest)#444.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#447.src: Ah! So you defeated her, and she fled into the rifts. Very good work, deerling.
Apotheosis (Quest)#447.dst: 아! 쓰러뜨렸더니 그 여자가 틈새로 도망쳤군요. 아주 잘했어요, 꼬마 사슴.
Apotheosis (Quest)#447.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#448.src: ...by most metrics, we've achieved our goal. Her Majesty has been dethroned, her Sovereigns either killed or turned - we have something to work with.
Apotheosis (Quest)#448.dst: ...대부분의 기준으로 보면 우린 목표를 이뤘어요. 여왕 폐하는 폐위됐고, 군주들은 죽거나 돌아섰으니 - 해 볼 만한 게 생겼죠.
Apotheosis (Quest)#448.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#449.src: But this rift... there's very little we can do while it's there. The people are panicked, the soldiers scattered, defensive, lost - and that isn't to mention whatever adverse effects it may or may not have!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#449.dst: 하지만 이 틈새... 저게 있는 한 할 수 있는 게 거의 없어요. 사람들은 겁에 질렸고, 병사들은 흩어져 몸만 사리고 갈피를 못 잡아요 - 게다가 저게 어떤 악영향을 줄지는 말할 것도 없고요!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#449.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#450.src: Perhaps if it can be cut off at its source...
Apotheosis (Quest)#450.dst: 근원에서 끊어 낼 수 있다면 어쩌면...
Apotheosis (Quest)#450.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#451.src: What, you mean passing through it into whatever it is on the other side? All in the hopes of chasing down the Queen? Who would be insane enough to even consider-
Apotheosis (Quest)#451.dst: 뭐요, 저걸 통과해서 반대편에 뭐가 있든 거기로 가자고요? 여왕을 쫓겠다는 희망 하나로? 대체 누가 그런 미친 생각을-
Apotheosis (Quest)#451.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#452.src: Right! Of course, how could I forget! We have you. Well, I suppose that's all sorted then - not a problem I need concern myself with. What a relief.
Apotheosis (Quest)#452.dst: 맞다! 물론이죠, 내가 왜 잊었지! 우리한텐 당신이 있잖아요. 뭐, 그럼 해결됐네요 - 내가 신경 쓸 문제가 아니죠. 다행이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#452.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#453.src: Hm. Leaves us more time to finalize the stabilizing plan for the province, to deal with the chaos that comes after this chaos concludes. Joy.
Apotheosis (Quest)#453.dst: 흠. 그럼 지방을 안정시킬 계획을 마무리할 시간이 더 생기겠네요. 이 혼돈이 끝난 뒤 찾아올 혼돈에 대비해서요. 신나네요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#453.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#454.src: Yes, yes... we can get to that. {u}, before you set off on yet another dangerous mission, you'd best go speak to everyone here. Alleviate some concerns, yes?
Apotheosis (Quest)#454.dst: 네, 네... 그건 나중에 하죠. {u}, 또 위험한 임무를 떠나기 전에 여기 있는 사람들과 얘기해 보는 게 좋겠어요. 걱정 좀 덜어 주세요, 네?
Apotheosis (Quest)#454.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#456.src: Ughhhhh... yeah, bro, I'm fine! Quit hovering!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.dst: 으으으... 그래, 형, 괜찮다니까! 그만 좀 맴돌아!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#457.src: Well, sorry for being worried under these circumstances! The SKY is broken, Yuman, so let me hover at least a little, okay?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.dst: 이런 상황에 걱정해서 미안하네! 하늘이 '부서졌어', Yuman, 그러니까 좀 맴돌게 해 줘, 알았어?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#458.src: Well, a...at least the soldiers have b- ba- backed off a little... so, that's s- something.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.dst: 뭐, 저, 적어도 병사들이 조금 무, 물러났어... 그러니까, 그건 다, 다행이야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#459.src: Sigh... yeah, that is something. I'm almost out of electrical charges...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.dst: 하아... 그래, 그건 다행이지. 전기 충전탄이 거의 다 떨어졌거든...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#462.src: S...so does that mean you... y- you stopped her?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.dst: 그, 그럼 네가... 그, 그 여자를 막은 거야?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#465.src: ...I hear a "but" added on to the end. Where are Rex and Sui?
Apotheosis (Quest)#465.dst: ...끝에 '하지만'이 붙는 게 들리는데. Rex랑 Sui는 어디 있어?
Apotheosis (Quest)#465.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#469.src: B...but she's... sh- she's okay, now...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#469.dst: 그, 그래도 이, 이제 괜찮은 거지...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#469.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#470.src: ...man. Man. That... that really sucks, huh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#470.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#471.src: Her... h- her bow... she's n- ne- never gonna be able to... use it ag- again...
Apotheosis (Quest)#471.dst: Rex의... 화, 활... 이제 다, 다, 다시는... 못 쓰, 쓰겠네...
Apotheosis (Quest)#471.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#472.src: I didn't even consider that... man. So, then... Sui's with her still?
Apotheosis (Quest)#472.dst: 그건 생각도 못 했어... 이런. 그럼... Sui는 아직 Rex 곁에 있어?
Apotheosis (Quest)#472.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#473.src: She's... in good hands, at least. Multiple Sovereigns, turning to our side... it's a little hard to believe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#473.dst: 그래도... 좋은 사람들 손에 있잖아. 군주 여럿이 우리 편으로 돌아서다니... 좀 믿기지가 않네.
Apotheosis (Quest)#473.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#474.src: But this is good. If they've turned against the Queen... it'll make things easier for us once this is all over.
Apotheosis (Quest)#474.dst: 그래도 잘된 일이야. 그들이 여왕에게 등을 돌렸다면... 다 끝난 뒤에 우리 일이 훨씬 수월해질 거야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#474.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#475.src: Guess so... WAIT! So Zhiraok broke Soosu out of prison?! Was that-
Apotheosis (Quest)#475.dst: 그런가 보네... 잠깐! 그럼 Zhiraok가 Soosu를 감옥에서 빼낸 거야?! 그게-
Apotheosis (Quest)#475.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#476.src: -wh- what we saw? It was a- a flash of s- so- something, going into and out of the p...palace! Just before the sk...sky broke.
Apotheosis (Quest)#476.dst: -우, 우리가 본 거? 왕, 왕궁 안으로 뭔, 뭔가 번쩍하고 들어갔다 나왔어! 하, 하늘이 부서지기 직전에.
Apotheosis (Quest)#476.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#477.src: It must've been! That explains some things! Hey, no wonder the soldiers were so confused!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#477.dst: 그거였겠네! 그럼 설명이 되지! 야, 어쩐지 병사들이 그렇게 허둥대더라!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#477.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#479.src: ...{u}. The Queen isn't d...dead, is she?
Apotheosis (Quest)#479.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#480.src: Then... y...you're going after her. Right?
Apotheosis (Quest)#480.dst: 그럼... 너, 너 그 여자 쫓아가는 거지. 맞지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#480.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#481.src: Zeph... you're not thinking of going in there too, are you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#481.dst: Zeph... 설마 너도 거기 들어갈 생각은 아니지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#481.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#484.src: I- I have to... Rex won't be in any sh- shape to fight, a- and- and it's my turn to do my p...part anyway!
Apotheosis (Quest)#484.dst: 나, 나도 가야 해... Rex는 싸, 싸울 상태가 아니고, 그, 그리고 이번엔 내가 제 몫을 할 차, 차례야!
Apotheosis (Quest)#484.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#485.src: ... Fine. But you have to come back, princess! We've got plans, remember? I still have to show you where I grew up, and-
Apotheosis (Quest)#485.dst: ... 좋아. 대신 꼭 돌아와야 해, 공주님! 우리 계획 있잖아, 기억하지? 내가 자란 곳도 보여 줘야 하고, 그리고-
Apotheosis (Quest)#485.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#486.src: -and sh...show me your favourite food stand from when you were gr...growing up, I- I know. I'll be b- back.
Apotheosis (Quest)#486.dst: -어, 어릴 때 제일 좋아하던 노점도 보, 보여 주기로 했지, 아, 알아. 돌, 돌아올게.
Apotheosis (Quest)#486.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#487.src: Okay, lovebirds, that's my signal to get out of here. There's schedules I have to organize...
Apotheosis (Quest)#487.dst: 그래, 잉꼬들, 난 이만 빠질게. 정리할 일정이 산더미라...
Apotheosis (Quest)#487.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#488.src: ...but yeah. Zeph, {u}, I expect to see you two again. Understood?
Apotheosis (Quest)#488.dst: ...그래도. Zeph, {u}, 둘 다 다시 볼 줄 알아. 알았지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#488.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#490.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you're back.
Apotheosis (Quest)#490.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#491.src: I heard from Zeph that you and the girls decided to challenge Her Majesty.
Apotheosis (Quest)#491.dst: Zeph한테 들었어요. 당신과 그 애들이 여왕 폐하에게 도전하기로 했다고요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#491.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#492.src: How... how did it go? I can't help notice the lack of companions by your side.
Apotheosis (Quest)#492.dst: 어... 어떻게 됐어요? 곁에 동료들이 안 보여서 신경이 쓰이네요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#492.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#493.src: Sui has grown into quite the powerful cursed one, huh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#493.dst: Sui가 꽤 강한 저주받은 자로 자랐구나, 그렇지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#493.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#494.src: Did I hear that right... Soosu?
Apotheosis (Quest)#494.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#495.src: That... is an unexpected turn of events. However, you may accept their change of heart but for the rest of us...
Apotheosis (Quest)#495.dst: 그건... 뜻밖의 전개로구나. 하지만 네가 그들의 변심을 받아들인다 해도, 나머지 우리는...
Apotheosis (Quest)#495.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#496.src: They are an extension of her Majesty. All the pain and suffering they have caused is because of them.
Apotheosis (Quest)#496.dst: 그들은 여왕 폐하의 연장이야. 그들이 일으킨 모든 고통과 괴로움은 그들 탓이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#496.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#498.src: We have been thinking about how to handle the aftermath; in case we were successful. The larger populous knows of us as only terrorists. They would never accept us to rebuild Fruma.
Apotheosis (Quest)#498.dst: 성공할 경우를 대비해 뒷수습을 어떻게 할지 고민해 왔어요. 대다수 민중은 우릴 테러리스트로만 알아요. Fruma 재건을 우리에게 맡기지 않을 거예요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#498.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#499.src: But. With the Sovereigns on our side, the people might, they just might, hear them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#499.dst: 하지만. 군주들이 우리 편이라면, 사람들이 어쩌면, 정말 어쩌면 귀를 기울일지도요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#499.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#500.src: Ugh. You're right. This is the best option we got.
Apotheosis (Quest)#500.dst: 하. 네 말이 맞다. 지금 우리에게 가장 나은 선택지야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#500.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#501.src: We will need to arrange a meeting with them to discuss moving forwards. I expect it to be tense, even hostile. But, but we can do this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#501.dst: 앞으로를 논의하려면 그들과 회담을 잡아야 해요. 긴장되고, 적대적이기까지 하겠죠. 하지만, 하지만 해낼 수 있어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#501.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#502.src: I'll get Fuhue to draft up our plan, then.
Apotheosis (Quest)#502.dst: 그럼 Fuhue에게 계획 초안을 짜라고 하마.
Apotheosis (Quest)#502.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#504.src: Went without a scratch, of course.
Apotheosis (Quest)#504.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#505.src: Well, we did have a lot of issues... I wasn't worried but I'm glad Zeph and Cileon returned with us.
Apotheosis (Quest)#505.dst: 뭐, 문제가 많긴 했죠... 걱정은 안 했지만 Zeph와 Cileon이 같이 돌아와서 다행이에요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#505.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#506.src: Fuhue's talismans were doing a lot of the heavy listing in their absence.
Apotheosis (Quest)#506.dst: 둘이 없는 동안은 Fuhue의 호부가 궂은일을 거의 다 떠맡았어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#506.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#507.src: The Canopy will be helping with the aftermath. I don't care for becoming a public figure after this is over. though.
Apotheosis (Quest)#507.dst: Canopy도 뒷수습을 도울 거예요. 그래도 이게 끝나면 전 공인이 될 생각은 없어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#507.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#508.src: The trees are calling my name and the {p} is definitely not the place for me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#508.dst: 나무들이 내 이름을 부르고 있고, {p}은(는) 확실히 제 자리가 아니거든요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#508.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#509.src: Besides, could you ever see such a hunk like me become a politician... Pshh, at least I can't.
Apotheosis (Quest)#509.dst: 게다가, 저 같은 멋진 사내가 정치가가 되는 게 상상이 가요... 풉, 적어도 전 안 가요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#509.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#512.src: Foxes and I cleared them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#512.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#513.src: I want to return to the forest.
Apotheosis (Quest)#513.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#514.src: Need to hunt, run and stay away from... cities.
Apotheosis (Quest)#514.dst: 사냥하고, 달리고, 멀리 있고 싶다... 도시에서.
Apotheosis (Quest)#514.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#517.src: My talismans did the trick. Managed to keep up a temporary barrier for some time.
Apotheosis (Quest)#517.dst: 제 호부가 효과가 있었어요. 한동안 임시 방벽을 유지할 수 있었죠.
Apotheosis (Quest)#517.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#518.src: Unfortunately, they only last for some time and my schedule has not allowed me to create more. It was a miscalculation on my side.
Apotheosis (Quest)#518.dst: 안타깝게도 오래가지 않는 데다 일정상 더 만들 시간이 없었어요. 제 계산 착오였어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#518.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#519.src: I have completely, utterly failed as the Deer's captain. I totally underestimated how many barrier talismans we needed!
Apotheosis (Quest)#519.dst: 사슴의 대장으로서 완전히, 철저히 실패했어요. 방벽 호부가 얼마나 필요할지 완전히 과소평가했어요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#519.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#520.src: The Canopy will remain. Master has asked me to document everything that has transpired in the past coupl of weeks. It will take me at least one week and three days to compile it all.
Apotheosis (Quest)#520.dst: Canopy는 남을 거예요. 스승님이 지난 몇 주간 일어난 일을 전부 기록하라고 하셨거든요. 다 정리하려면 최소 1주 3일은 걸릴 거예요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#520.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#521.src: Besides, without the Queen a new government will have to be established. I am planning to be of assistance, there as well.
Apotheosis (Quest)#521.dst: 게다가 여왕이 없으니 새 정부를 세워야 하죠. 거기서도 도움이 될 생각이에요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#521.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#524.src: When we got- got back we had almost been c-completely overtaken.
Apotheosis (Quest)#524.dst: 우리가 도, 돌아왔을 때 거의 와, 완전히 점령당하기 직전이었어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#524.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#525.src: I'd like t-to -to believe I helped but... to be honest Rurie did most of the w-work.
Apotheosis (Quest)#525.dst: 나도 도, 도움이 됐다고 믿고 싶지만... 솔직히 Rurie가 거의 다 했어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#525.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#526.src: I felt guilty that I- I left you guys.
Apotheosis (Quest)#526.dst: 너, 너희를 두고 떠난 게 마음에 걸렸어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#526.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#527.src: But I will n-not back down for this final showdown!
Apotheosis (Quest)#527.dst: 그래도 이 마지막 결전에선 무, 물러서지 않을 거야!
Apotheosis (Quest)#527.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#529.src: It's, it's weird. After everything we've g-gone through, after everyone we- we- we lost. I have hope for the future.
Apotheosis (Quest)#529.dst: 이, 이상해. 그 모든 일을 겪, 겪고, 그 많은 사람을 이, 이, 잃었는데. 미래에 희망이 생겼어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#529.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#530.src: I promised myself when... when I was captured that if I- I made it out, I would not let my life fly by. I will l-live for Syndra and Mora. I will k-keep Syndra's legacy going.
Apotheosis (Quest)#530.dst: 붙, 붙잡혔을 때 다짐했어, 여기서 나, 나가면 인생을 그냥 흘려보내지 않겠다고. Syndra와 Mora를 위해 사, 살 거야. Syndra의 유지를 이, 이어 갈 거야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#530.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#531.src: And I made a p-promise to Yuman. I w-want to explore the world with- with him.
Apotheosis (Quest)#531.dst: 그리고 Yuman이랑 야, 약속했어. 그, 그 애랑 세상을 탐험하고 싶어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#531.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#532.src: I don't think I- I will n-never be ready but, I want to do all that I c-can.
Apotheosis (Quest)#532.dst: 준, 준비가 됐다고는 영, 영영 못 할 것 같지만, 할 수 있는 건 다 하고 싶어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#532.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#533.src: I won't be a hinderance to you. I k-know you and Sui are strong but... I'm not h-helpless.
Apotheosis (Quest)#533.dst: 짐이 되진 않을게. 너랑 Sui가 강한 건 아, 알지만... 나도 무, 무력하진 않아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#533.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#534.src: I'll follow you whenever you're r-ready, friend.
Apotheosis (Quest)#534.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#536.src: Things were looking veeery hairy for a bit. Luckily, Rurie brought back up just in time.
Apotheosis (Quest)#536.dst: 한동안 상황이 아주아주 아슬아슬했어. 다행히 Rurie가 딱 맞춰 지원을 데려왔지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#536.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#537.src: Those Canopy people can be quite scary, I must say.
Apotheosis (Quest)#537.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#538.src: I know that chaos is sure to ensue with Her Majesty gone but, I don't think I'm the best at... cleaning up a province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#538.dst: 여왕 폐하가 사라졌으니 한바탕 난리가 날 건 알지만, 난... 지방을 수습하는 데는 영 소질이 없는 것 같아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#538.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#539.src: I would honestly love to see the world. Traveling the world with someone you like sounds... nice.
Apotheosis (Quest)#539.dst: 솔직히 세상 구경을 하고 싶어. 좋아하는 사람이랑 세계 여행이라니... 멋지잖아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#539.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#540.src: I also miss the Steel Feather. I don't know what will happen to that place, or what has happened for that matter, but that place will always be my home.
Apotheosis (Quest)#540.dst: Steel Feather도 그리워. 거기가 어떻게 될지, 아니 이미 어떻게 됐는지도 모르지만, 거긴 언제나 내 집이야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#540.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#543.src: I'm just glad we managed to sort the situation.
Apotheosis (Quest)#543.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#544.src: My electric charges almost ran out and I would have been useless without them.
Apotheosis (Quest)#544.dst: 전기 충전탄이 거의 바닥났었거든. 그거 없으면 난 쓸모없었을 거야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#544.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#545.src: Honestly, I'm ready to deal with the fall out of this revolution.
Apotheosis (Quest)#545.dst: 솔직히, 이 혁명의 뒷감당을 할 준비는 됐어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#545.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#546.src: I want to make a difference. I want to make sure the new Fruma is a good place. It will for sure take some time. But, I'm ready to spend the rest of my life bettering the province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#546.dst: 변화를 만들고 싶어. 새로운 Fruma를 좋은 곳으로 만들고 싶어. 분명 시간이 걸리겠지. 그래도 남은 평생을 이 지방을 낫게 만드는 데 쓸 각오야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#546.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#547.src: I better be seeing you later.
Apotheosis (Quest)#547.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#549.src: I intend to make up for my past mistakes. I don't think I told you this before but, the wall that separates the {p} from the Roughworks was designed by me during my university stay.
Apotheosis (Quest)#549.dst: 과거의 실수를 만회할 생각이에요. 전에 말 안 했던 것 같은데, {p}과(와) Roughworks를 가르는 벽은 제가 대학 시절에 설계했어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#549.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#550.src: I thought- I thought I was protecting the people of the Roughworks from the dangers of the {p}. But in reality, all I did was separate the people.
Apotheosis (Quest)#550.dst: 저는- 저는 Roughworks 사람들을 {p}의 위험에서 지키는 줄 알았어요. 하지만 실제론 사람들을 갈라놓았을 뿐이죠.
Apotheosis (Quest)#550.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#551.src: Fruma needs all the help it can get once this is all over. Everyone will need to cooperate to save the province from destroying itself without a ruler.
Apotheosis (Quest)#551.dst: 이게 다 끝나면 Fruma는 모든 도움이 필요할 거예요. 통치자 없이 지방이 스스로 무너지지 않게 하려면 모두가 협력해야 해요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#551.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#554.src: I might hand the responsibilities for liberating Fruma to the young ones.
Apotheosis (Quest)#554.dst: Fruma 해방의 책임은 젊은이들에게 넘길까 싶구나.
Apotheosis (Quest)#554.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#555.src: I've lived long enough and honestly, retirement sounds rather nice.
Apotheosis (Quest)#555.dst: 난 살 만큼 살았고, 솔직히 은퇴도 꽤 괜찮게 들리거든.
Apotheosis (Quest)#555.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#561.src: She, um... she is. S-Sovereign Zhiraok, he, um, took her to a medic. And... went to try to get control of the army.
Apotheosis (Quest)#561.dst: Rex는, 음... 괜찮아. Z, Zhiraok 군주가, 음, 의무병한테 데려갔어. 그리고... 군대를 장악하러 갔어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#561.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#562.src: ...I don't want to think about him. Or- or Soosu. I don't... like that everything's just- j-just okay now. Because of a common enemy.
Apotheosis (Quest)#562.dst: ...그 사람 생각은 하기 싫어. 아, 아니면 Soosu도. 난... 공통의 적이 있다고 해서 모든 게 그냥- 그, 그냥 괜찮아진 게 싫어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#562.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#563.src: So... later. I'll think about it later. After we're d-
Apotheosis (Quest)#563.dst: 그러니까... 나중에. 나중에 생각할래. 우리가 끝낸 다-
Apotheosis (Quest)#563.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#564.src: Sui!!! I- I- I heard about what you g...guys did!! You st- st- stopped the Queen!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#564.dst: Sui!!! 너, 너, 너희가 한 일 드, 들었어!! 여왕을 마, 마, 막았다며!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#564.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#565.dst: ...응. Rex랑 {u}이(가) 한 거야. 난... 못 했어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#565.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#566.src: What? Sui, you he- held back the lake's water from fl- fl- flooding the {p}!! If it wasn't for y...you, then-
Apotheosis (Quest)#566.dst: 뭐? Sui, 넌 호수 물이 {p}을(를) 휩, 휩, 휩쓸지 않게 막았잖아!! 네, 네가 아니었으면-
Apotheosis (Quest)#566.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#567.src: It doesn't MATTER! While I was stuck h-holding back the flood, I- I couldn't help fight!! Again - AGAIN!!! - someone got hurt because I COULDN'T BE THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#567.dst: 그게 뭐가 중요해! 난 홍수를 마, 막느라 묶여서 같이 못 싸웠어!! 또 - 또다시!!! - 내가 거기 없어서 누가 다쳤다고!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#567.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#568.src: Rex. She... she died, Zeph, I felt it. For a minute, I was holding her- her cold, LIFELESS BODY in my hands, and- a-and it was like I was there again. With... M-Mora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#568.dst: Rex. Rex는... 죽었었어, Zeph, 난 느꼈어. 잠깐이지만 Rex의- 차갑고 생명 없는 몸을 안고 있었는데, 그, 그게 꼭 다시 그때 같았어. M, Mora 때처럼.
Apotheosis (Quest)#568.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#569.src: ...I failed again. I told myself, if I was STRONGER, if I was BETTER, it WOULDN'T HAPPEN AGAIN!! And it DID!!! Even if she got better, even if she's not dead, it's still MY FAULT!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#569.dst: ...또 실패했어. 내가 더 강하면, 더 나으면, 다시는 이런 일 없을 거라고 다짐했는데!! 또 일어났어!!! 나아졌어도, 안 죽었어도, 여전히 내 잘못이야!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#569.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#571.src: A- and if you were able to s...save Rex, but the dam broke... and all th- those people died instead... would that have been b- be- better?
Apotheosis (Quest)#571.dst: 그, 그럼 네가 Rex를 구, 구했는데 댐이 무너져서... 그 사, 사람들이 대신 다 죽었다면... 그게 더, 더 나았을까?
Apotheosis (Quest)#571.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#573.src: I've b...been thinking about it, ever since {u} t- told me... if- if I had been th- there, a- and not here, could I have st...stopped it...? A- an extra pair of eyes...
Apotheosis (Quest)#573.dst: {u}한테 드, 들은 뒤로 계속 생각했어... 내, 내가 거, 거기 있었다면, 여기가 아니라, 막, 막을 수 있었을까...? 누, 눈이 하나라도 더 있었다면...
Apotheosis (Quest)#573.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#574.src: B- but I was here, instead, a- a- and because of that, I was able to m...make sure Yuman survived! If it were the other way around... I'd feel the same!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#574.dst: 하, 하지만 난 여기 있었고, 그, 그, 그래서 Yuman이 살아남게 할 수 있었어! 반대였어도... 난 똑같이 느꼈을 거야!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#574.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#576.src: She's still out there. Through that rift. We're going to kill her, Zeph.
Apotheosis (Quest)#576.dst: 그 여자는 아직 저기 있어. 저 틈새 너머에. 우리가 죽일 거야, Zeph.
Apotheosis (Quest)#576.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#577.src: ...right now? Sui, are you s...sure? Controlling that much water, it mu- must have drained your mana... can you st...still fight?
Apotheosis (Quest)#577.dst: ...지금? Sui, 괜, 괜찮아? 그 많은 물을 다뤘으면 마나가 바, 바닥났을 텐데... 아, 아직 싸울 수 있어?
Apotheosis (Quest)#577.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#578.src: ...yes. I... it doesn't feel like I've used any magic at all. I, um, don't feel tired at all.
Apotheosis (Quest)#578.dst: ...응. 난... 마법을 하나도 안 쓴 느낌이야. 난, 음, 전혀 안 피곤해.
Apotheosis (Quest)#578.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#579.src: Ever since the {p}, the ocean's... grown. Or... no, that's wrong - it was always this big, I just... couldn't see it before.
Apotheosis (Quest)#579.dst: {p} 이후로 바다가... 커졌어. 아니... 틀렸어 - 원래 이만큼 컸는데, 내가... 전엔 못 봤던 거야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#579.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#580.src: It's... mana, but it's not mine. It's... all the strands, the threads, tied up in everything. And I can, um, use as much as I want.
Apotheosis (Quest)#580.dst: 그건... 마나인데, 내 게 아니야. 그건... 모든 것에 얽힌 가닥들, 실들이야. 그리고 난, 음, 원하는 만큼 쓸 수 있어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#580.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#581.src: ...okay. So y- you- you're going now...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#581.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#583.src: Th- then let me join you! Things are c...calmer here, now, so- so they should be fine w- with- without me!
Apotheosis (Quest)#583.dst: 그, 그럼 나도 같이 갈게! 여긴 이제 조, 좀 잠잠하니까, 나 어, 없이도 괜찮을 거야!
Apotheosis (Quest)#583.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#584.src: ...okay, Zeph. We could use the help.
Apotheosis (Quest)#584.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#586.src: I- I did it! I finally, finally, FINALLY did it!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#586.dst: 해, 해냈어요! 드디어, 드디어, 드디어 해냈어요!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#586.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#588.src: The Resonance Weaver - I had theories before, workable theories, but I wasn't sure. But I am now!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#588.dst: 공명 직조기요 - 전에도 이론은 있었어요, 쓸 만한 이론이요, 근데 확신이 없었죠. 이제는 확신해요!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#588.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#589.src: It was in the glyphs! They don't just call upon the five elements, they ARE the five elements! Like Soosu's writings about matter - building blocks of reality!
Apotheosis (Quest)#589.dst: 답은 문양에 있었어요! 문양은 다섯 원소를 부르는 게 아니라, 그 자체가 다섯 원소예요! Soosu가 물질에 대해 쓴 글처럼 - 현실의 구성 요소죠!
Apotheosis (Quest)#589.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#590.src: The Weaver pulls on these strands - the physical makeup of our reality - and uses them to... well... do mostly anything.
Apotheosis (Quest)#590.dst: 직조기는 이 가닥들 - 우리 현실의 물리적 구성 - 을 당겨서, 그걸로... 음... 거의 뭐든 할 수 있어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#590.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#591.src: I used it before to make that... corruption visible. But with enough experimenting, you could do more than just visualizing it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#591.dst: 전에 그걸로 그... 부패를 눈에 보이게 했잖아요. 그런데 실험을 충분히 하면 보이게 하는 것 이상도 가능해요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#591.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#592.src: Thread it into something else, or change the course of its flow, or... or even bind it to something physical!
Apotheosis (Quest)#592.dst: 다른 것에 엮어 넣거나, 흐름의 방향을 바꾸거나, 심지어... 물체에 묶어 둘 수도 있어요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#592.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#593.src: ...I didn't see her transform. What did it look like?
Apotheosis (Quest)#593.dst: ...난 그 여자가 변신하는 걸 못 봤어. 어떤 모습이었어?
Apotheosis (Quest)#593.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#594.src: S...so, what, that's how she b- became... human?
Apotheosis (Quest)#594.dst: 그, 그러니까, 뭐, 그렇게 해서 그 여자가 인, 인간이 된 거야?
Apotheosis (Quest)#594.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#595.src: ...I don't really care. Yusanu, can it help with our... um, our rift problem?
Apotheosis (Quest)#595.dst: ...별로 관심 없어. Yusanu, 그걸로 우리... 음, 틈새 문제를 해결할 수 있어?
Apotheosis (Quest)#595.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#596.src: Uh... maybe. To- to be clear, the Weaver is still... hard to use. If we had people more familiar with the glyphs... it could be very powerful. But we don't.
Apotheosis (Quest)#596.dst: 어... 아마도요. 부, 분명히 말하자면 직조기는 아직... 다루기 어려워요. 문양에 더 익숙한 사람이 있으면... 엄청 강력할 텐데. 없죠.
Apotheosis (Quest)#596.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#597.src: In theory... it should be able to close the rifts. Would just- ha, need to weave reality shut again. But... I don't know how.
Apotheosis (Quest)#597.dst: 이론상으로는... 틈새를 닫을 수 있을 거예요. 그냥- 하, 현실을 다시 꿰매서 닫으면 되죠. 근데... 방법을 몰라요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#597.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#598.src: Um... S-Soveriegn Soosu might know. She and- a-and Zhiraok are... no longer against us. F-for now, at least.
Apotheosis (Quest)#598.dst: 음... S, Soosu 군주가 알지도 몰라. Soosu랑- 그, 그리고 Zhiraok는 이제... 우리 적이 아니야. 저, 적어도 지금은.
Apotheosis (Quest)#598.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#599.src: ...got it. I'll see what I can do..
Apotheosis (Quest)#599.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#600.src: You're... heading in to deal with the source, aren't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#600.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#602.src: Then... good luck. Don't die. Be careful. We'll hold the fort while you're gone, until everything stabilizes, at least.
Apotheosis (Quest)#602.dst: 그럼... 행운을 빌어요. 죽지 마요. 조심하고요. 떠나 있는 동안 여긴 우리가 지킬게요, 적어도 다 안정될 때까지는요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#602.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#603.src: ...yeah. We should get going. See you when it's all over.
Apotheosis (Quest)#603.dst: ...응. 이제 가야 해. 다 끝나면 보자.
Apotheosis (Quest)#603.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#604.src: Head to the Royal Palace at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#606.src: It's fine. My mana has never been stronger. You don't have to worry about me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#606.dst: 괜찮아. 마나가 이렇게 강했던 적은 없어. 내 걱정은 안 해도 돼.
Apotheosis (Quest)#606.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#608.src: Awful, empty, sad, enraged... Does that paint you a clear picture? But I can't afford that. Not, now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#608.dst: 끔찍하고, 텅 비고, 슬프고, 화나... 이러면 확실히 알겠어? 그래도 그럴 여유 없어. 지금은.
Apotheosis (Quest)#608.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#609.src: I... I still haven't given it much thought.
Apotheosis (Quest)#609.dst: 난... 아직 별로 생각 안 해 봤어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#609.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#610.src: I'll think about it if- when we kill her for good.
Apotheosis (Quest)#610.dst: 그 여자를- 완전히 죽이고 나면 생각할게.
Apotheosis (Quest)#610.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#613.src: To be honest. If it weren't for your information about worlds beyond ours, I would never have figured it out. Besides, Sui taught me a lot about magic which helped...
Apotheosis (Quest)#613.dst: 솔직히요. 우리 세계 너머 다른 세계에 대한 당신 정보가 없었으면 절대 못 알아냈을 거예요. 게다가 Sui가 마법을 많이 가르쳐 줘서 도움이 됐고요...
Apotheosis (Quest)#613.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#614.src: At the end of the day, Soosu has taught me to... think outside of the box and I have gotten quite used to how she builds her inventions.
Apotheosis (Quest)#614.dst: 결국엔 Soosu가... 틀에서 벗어나 생각하는 법을 가르쳐 줬고, 그 사람 발명품 짜는 방식에도 꽤 익숙해졌어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#614.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#615.src: I haven't been able to test my theory on the use but I'm {~} certain it will work.
Apotheosis (Quest)#615.dst: 사용법에 대한 이론은 아직 시험 못 했지만 {~} 확신해요, 될 거예요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#615.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#616.src: I have a lot I want to do. I feel like a world of opportunity has opened for me. I want to travel the world, explore the other provinces and share research.
Apotheosis (Quest)#616.dst: 하고 싶은 게 많아요. 기회의 세상이 열린 기분이에요. 세계를 여행하고, 다른 지방도 탐험하고, 연구도 나누고 싶어요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#616.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#617.src: But more importantly, I heard from Quill that Soosu is alive. I think- I think she should join me on my travels. Once the aftermath has calmed down a bit.
Apotheosis (Quest)#617.dst: 근데 그보다, Quill한테 Soosu가 살아 있다고 들었어요. 제 생각엔- Soosu도 제 여행에 같이 가야 할 것 같아요. 뒷수습이 좀 가라앉으면요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#617.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#620.src: I've.. done what I can. Reached as many people as I could, with the time I had. The rest...
Apotheosis (Quest)#620.dst: 난.. 할 수 있는 건 했어. 주어진 시간 동안 최대한 많은 사람에게 닿으려 했어. 나머지는...
Apotheosis (Quest)#620.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#621.src: The gendarme won't listen to me... their commander's disappeared somewhere, and they won't tell me anything about it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#621.dst: 헌병대는 내 말을 안 들어... 지휘관이 어딘가로 사라졌는데, 그것에 대해선 아무것도 말을 안 해.
Apotheosis (Quest)#621.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#622.src: ...I thought she understood me. I still think she did, but... it doesn't make up for this. Any of this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#622.dst: ...그녀가 날 이해한다고 생각했어. 지금도 그렇게 생각하지만... 이 일을 메워 주진 못해. 어느 것도.
Apotheosis (Quest)#622.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#623.src: The cracks are finally showing... I always knew they were there, I just. Told myself they weren't the end of the world. Ha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#623.dst: 마침내 금이 드러나고 있어... 늘 거기 있는 걸 알았어, 난 그냥. 세상이 끝날 일은 아니라고 되뇌었지. 하.
Apotheosis (Quest)#623.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#624.src: ...it's strange. For all that I thought she understood me... maybe she never really did. How much of what she said was real? How much of it wasn't?
Apotheosis (Quest)#624.dst: ...이상하지. 그녀가 날 이해한다고 그렇게 믿었는데... 사실 한 번도 이해한 적 없는지도 몰라. 그녀 말 중 얼마나 진짜였을까? 얼마나 아니었을까?
Apotheosis (Quest)#624.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#625.src: The cracks had been showing for a while, I just... chose to push them aside. I didn't think I would make it out of this, so... why push back on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#625.dst: 금은 한참 전부터 드러났었어, 난 그냥... 외면하기로 한 거야. 여기서 살아 나갈 거라 생각 안 했으니... 굳이 맞설 필요가 있었겠어?
Apotheosis (Quest)#625.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#626.src: ...I still think her plan would have worked to stop the end of the world. She had the method and the means...
Apotheosis (Quest)#626.dst: ...그래도 그녀의 계획이면 세상의 끝을 막을 수 있었을 거라 생각해. 방법도 수단도 있었으니까...
Apotheosis (Quest)#626.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#627.src: But it was never her priority. She was always focused on... this. Keeping Fruma perfect, and under her control.
Apotheosis (Quest)#627.dst: 하지만 그건 한 번도 우선이 아니었어. 그녀는 늘... 이것만 봤어. Fruma를 완벽하게, 자기 손아귀에 두는 것.
Apotheosis (Quest)#627.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#628.src: ...does any of this matter? I guess not. We've found ourselves here, either way. Nothing to do but... keep moving forward.
Apotheosis (Quest)#628.dst: ...이게 다 의미가 있을까? 없겠지. 어쨌든 우린 여기 왔어. 할 수 있는 건... 계속 나아가는 것뿐이야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#628.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#629.src: YOU!!! {u}, what is HE doing here?! After he- he- he KILLED Rex, so why is he HERE?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#629.dst: 너!!! {u}, '저 사람'이 왜 여기 있어?! Rex를- Rex를- Rex를 죽였는데, 왜 여기 있냐고?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#629.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#630.src: I should... I should kill you. You- you'd DESERVE it, for everything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#630.dst: 널... 널 죽여야 해. 너- 넌 그래도 싸, 그 모든 일 때문에!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#630.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#632.src: ...maybe. Maybe I do. But I can't just leave my mistakes for other people to deal with.
Apotheosis (Quest)#632.dst: ...그럴지도. 그래도 싸겠지. 하지만 내 실수를 남한테 떠넘기고 떠날 순 없어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#632.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#633.src: I'm here to help with the Queen. I have to see it through, or... or I've made these mistakes for nothing.
Apotheosis (Quest)#633.dst: 여왕 일을 도우러 왔어. 끝까지 해내야 해, 안 그러면... 안 그러면 이 실수들이 다 헛수고가 돼.
Apotheosis (Quest)#633.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#634.src: ...right. Of course you want to help, what else would you do? Sigh. Everyone who hurts me, always... out of reach.
Apotheosis (Quest)#634.dst: ...그렇겠지. 당연히 돕고 싶겠지, 달리 뭘 하겠어? 하아. 날 다치게 한 사람들은 늘... 손이 안 닿아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#634.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#635.src: Fine. Fine. Until this is done... I'll... ignore it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#635.dst: 좋아. 좋아. 이게 끝날 때까진... 신경... 안 쓸게.
Apotheosis (Quest)#635.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#636.src: I can't wait for this nightmare to be over...
Apotheosis (Quest)#636.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#638.src: I don't want to hear it. I don't care what you have to say for yourself.
Apotheosis (Quest)#638.dst: 듣고 싶지 않아. 네가 무슨 변명을 하든 상관없어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#638.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#641.src: {u}. I'm here, aren't I? Sigh... Look at it all. What a mess. The sky itself is cracked and broken!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#641.dst: {u}. 나 여기 왔잖아, 안 그래? 하아... 이걸 다 봐. 엉망진창이야. 하늘 자체가 금 가고 부서졌어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#641.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#642.src: Everything she said... it was true. She had a plan to stop the end of the world. She had the method and the means...
Apotheosis (Quest)#642.dst: 그녀가 한 말... 전부 사실이었어. 세상의 끝을 막을 계획이 있었어. 방법도 수단도 있었고...
Apotheosis (Quest)#642.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#643.src: But she was always focused on this, wasn't she? Fruma was her priority. Keeping it perfect and under her control...
Apotheosis (Quest)#643.dst: 하지만 늘 이것만 봤잖아, 안 그래? Fruma가 우선이었어. 완벽하게, 자기 손아귀에 두는 게...
Apotheosis (Quest)#643.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#644.src: Maybe I should have seen it. Maybe I did. But it doesn't matter, does it? We've found ourselves here and now either way.
Apotheosis (Quest)#644.dst: 더 일찍 알아챘어야 했는지도. 알아챘었는지도 몰라. 하지만 상관없잖아? 어쨌든 우린 지금 여기 있어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#644.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#645.src: YOU!!! {u}, what is HE doing here?! After he- he- he KILLED Rex, so why is he HERE?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#645.dst: 너!!! {u}, '저 사람'이 왜 여기 있어?! Rex를- Rex를- Rex를 죽였는데, 왜 여기 있냐고?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#645.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#646.src: I should... I should kill you. You- you'd DESERVE it, for everything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#646.dst: 널... 널 죽여야 해. 너- 넌 그래도 싸, 그 모든 일 때문에!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#646.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#648.src: ...I would, wouldn't I? But there are bigger things to worry about right now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#648.dst: ...그래도 싸겠지? 하지만 지금은 더 큰 걱정거리가 있어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#648.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#649.src: You're going after the Queen, right? I want to help.
Apotheosis (Quest)#649.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#650.src: Help. You want to... fine. Fine!! Of course you get to just... turn around and be good now. Of course...
Apotheosis (Quest)#650.dst: 돕는다. 네가... 좋아. 좋다고!! 당연히 넌 그냥... 돌아서서 이제 착한 사람이 되겠지. 당연히...
Apotheosis (Quest)#650.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#651.src: It's fine. It's fine! Until this is done... I'll... ignore it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#651.dst: 됐어. 됐다고! 이게 끝날 때까진... 신경... 안 쓸게.
Apotheosis (Quest)#651.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#652.src: I can't wait for this nightmare to be over...
Apotheosis (Quest)#652.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#653.src: ...I just want to make things right.
Apotheosis (Quest)#653.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#654.src: Well... you CAN'T!! Her arm is gone, FOREVER, and it's YOUR fault. She would have been DEAD, if it weren't for- f-for Zhiraok!
Apotheosis (Quest)#654.dst: 그래... 넌 못 해!! Rex의 팔은 영원히 없어졌고, 그건 네 잘못이야. Zh, Zhiraok가 아니었으면 Rex는 죽었을 거라고!
Apotheosis (Quest)#654.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#655.src: So... so I don't care. If you're going to help with the Queen... fine. But I don't want to see you ever again after we're done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#655.dst: 그러니까... 그러니까 상관없어. 여왕 일을 돕겠다면... 좋아. 하지만 끝나고 나면 다시는 보고 싶지 않아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#655.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#658.src: I've been thinking. About all of it. After everything that's happened, everything she's done - everything I've done - it wouldn't be right to turn away.
Apotheosis (Quest)#658.dst: 생각해 봤어. 전부 다. 그 모든 일, 그녀가 한 모든 일 - 내가 한 모든 일 - 을 겪고 나서 등을 돌리는 건 옳지 않아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#658.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#659.src: It's all broken, breaking... and maybe it always was. And this is just the truth finally being visible.
Apotheosis (Quest)#659.dst: 전부 부서졌고, 부서지고 있어... 어쩌면 원래 그랬는지도. 이제야 진실이 드러난 것뿐이고.
Apotheosis (Quest)#659.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#660.src: ...I just wanted to do something about it all. About the realms... but also about Fruma. But... I was never going to make any real change, was I?
Apotheosis (Quest)#660.dst: ...그냥 이 모든 것에 뭔가 하고 싶었어. 영역들을 위해서... 그리고 Fruma를 위해서도. 하지만... 애초에 진짜 변화 같은 건 못 만들었겠지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#660.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#661.src: I'll help you take her down. It's only right. After that... I don't know.
Apotheosis (Quest)#661.dst: 그 여자를 쓰러뜨리는 걸 도울게. 그게 옳아. 그다음은... 모르겠어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#661.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#662.src: YOU!!! {u}, what is HE doing here?! After he- he- he KILLED Rex, so why is he HERE?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#662.dst: 너!!! {u}, '저 사람'이 왜 여기 있어?! Rex를- Rex를- Rex를 죽였는데, 왜 여기 있냐고?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#662.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#663.src: I should... I should kill you. You- you'd DESERVE it, for everything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#663.dst: 널... 널 죽여야 해. 너- 넌 그래도 싸, 그 모든 일 때문에!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#663.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#665.src: W-well? What do you have to say for yourself?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#665.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#670.src: ...I can't. I... I can't do it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#670.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#671.src: After everything... after EVERYTHING, I get a CHANCE to- to- to get back at s-someone who's hurt me, and- and- a-and I CAN'T DO IT?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#671.dst: 그 모든 일을 겪고... 그 모든 걸 겪고, 날 다치게 한 사람한테 갚아 줄 기회가- 기회가- 왔는데, 그, 그런데 못 하겠다고?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#671.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#672.src: ...whatever. WAHTEVER!! Let's just go deal with the STUPID Queen!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#672.dst: ...몰라. 몰라!! 그냥 그 망할 여왕이나 처리하러 가자!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#672.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#673.src: I can't wait for this nightmare to be over...
Apotheosis (Quest)#673.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#681.src: How is- is this going to go?
Apotheosis (Quest)#681.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#683.src: And so, the cards fall. The shards collapse as decisions are made and paths are chosen. What a destructive end it has turned out to be.
Apotheosis (Quest)#683.dst: 그리하여 패가 떨어지는구나. 결정이 내려지고 길이 선택되며 파편이 무너진다. 참으로 파괴적인 결말이 되었구나.
Apotheosis (Quest)#683.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#684.src: In retrospect, it seems an inevitability... each decision branching out from the last. What was the weight that sent it over the edge? The tournament? The selection?
Apotheosis (Quest)#684.dst: 돌이켜 보면 필연처럼 보이는구나... 결정 하나하나가 앞의 것에서 가지를 쳤지. 무엇이 마지막 한 방울이었을까? 대회? 선발?
Apotheosis (Quest)#684.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#685.src: Would you have been the better choice? No. Having seen now what I have, I am only more certain. But perhaps it could have saved us all this mess.
Apotheosis (Quest)#685.dst: 네가 더 나은 선택이었을까? 아니. 내가 본 것을 보고 나니 더욱 확신한다. 허나 그랬다면 이 난장판은 피했을지도 모르지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#685.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#686.src: Oh, Anathema... what a mess you've left in your wake...
Apotheosis (Quest)#686.dst: 오, Anathema... 참으로 큰 난장판을 남기고 갔구나...
Apotheosis (Quest)#686.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#687.src: You will face no resistance from me. I do not have a death wish.
Apotheosis (Quest)#687.dst: 내게서 저항은 없을 것이다. 죽고 싶은 마음은 없으니.
Apotheosis (Quest)#687.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#688.src: So go on, fellow Scion. Put an end to this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#688.dst: 그러니 가거라, 같은 후예여. 이 일을 끝내라.
Apotheosis (Quest)#688.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#690.src: Sovereign, then? Deny it all you like, but you chose to take on that role.
Apotheosis (Quest)#690.dst: 그럼 군주라 부를까? 얼마든지 부정해도 좋다만, 그 역할을 맡기로 한 건 너였다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#690.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#691.src: As with each of us, that mark remains. It cannot be so easily discarded. It cannot be forgotten.
Apotheosis (Quest)#691.dst: 우리 모두가 그렇듯 그 표식은 남는다. 그리 쉽게 버릴 수 없다. 잊힐 수도 없다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#691.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#692.src: Her power gifted, drawn through the mark... and she has given much away in pursuit of this freedom, hasn't she...
Apotheosis (Quest)#692.dst: 그녀의 힘은 하사된 것, 표식을 통해 끌어온 것... 그리고 그녀는 이 자유를 좇느라 많은 걸 내주었지...
Apotheosis (Quest)#692.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#693.src: How much of it remains now, I wonder? Enough to guarantee her victory? Or, perhaps... little enough to grant you a chance of success...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#693.dst: 지금은 얼마나 남았을까? 승리를 보장할 만큼? 아니면 어쩌면... 너희에게 성공의 기회를 줄 만큼 적을까...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#693.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#694.src: Hm! I cannot say for certain. Of all things, this variable yet eludes me. The shards are inconclusive - equally favourable and not.
Apotheosis (Quest)#694.dst: 흠! 확언할 수 없구나. 무엇보다 이 변수만은 아직 내게 잡히지 않는다. 파편은 결론을 내지 않아 - 유리하기도, 불리하기도 하지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#694.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#695.src: But you... an unexpected variable, though not unwelcome. A naturally-born manaweaver! I thought I'd never see the day.
Apotheosis (Quest)#695.dst: 허나 너... 예상 밖의 변수로구나, 반갑지 않은 건 아니다만. 타고난 마나 직조자라니! 살아생전 볼 줄은 몰랐다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#695.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#697.src: ...naturally, you do not know the gift you possess. That knowledge was lost with the old world, after all. Will you grow into that power? Or will you allow it to consume you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#697.dst: ...당연히 네가 가진 재능을 모르겠지. 그 지식은 옛 세계와 함께 사라졌으니. 그 힘에 걸맞게 자라겠느냐? 아니면 그 힘에 삼켜지겠느냐?
Apotheosis (Quest)#697.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#699.src: And you. Do you remember what I asked you? If not Her, then who?
Apotheosis (Quest)#699.dst: 그리고 너. 내가 무엇을 물었는지 기억하느냐? 그녀가 아니라면, 누구냐고?
Apotheosis (Quest)#699.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#701.src: From here, there are no easy paths - your decisions have buried all of those. For Fruma, for the world... each step towards a better future will be a bitter, hard-fought victory.
Apotheosis (Quest)#701.dst: 여기서부턴 쉬운 길이 없다 - 너희의 결정이 그런 길을 모두 묻어 버렸지. Fruma를 위해, 세상을 위해... 더 나은 미래로 가는 한 걸음 한 걸음이 쓰디쓴 사투 끝의 승리가 되리라.
Apotheosis (Quest)#701.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#702.src: But perhaps it will prove worthwhile, after all! You've surprised me once already - who's to say you won't do it again? An uncertain future... what an exciting prospect.
Apotheosis (Quest)#702.dst: 허나 결국엔 그럴 가치가 있을지도 모르지! 넌 이미 한 번 날 놀라게 했다 - 다시 못 하리란 법이 있겠느냐? 불확실한 미래라... 참으로 흥미진진하구나.
Apotheosis (Quest)#702.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#703.src: I hope to see you all once more, somewhere down this winding road of ours.
Apotheosis (Quest)#703.dst: 이 구불구불한 길 어딘가에서 너희 모두를 다시 만나길 바란다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#703.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#706.src: I'm... I don't know. Saying goodbye, I guess.
Apotheosis (Quest)#706.dst: 난... 모르겠어. 작별 인사 하는 거겠지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#706.speaker: Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#708.src: I should... get going. I'll, uh... see you around.
Apotheosis (Quest)#708.speaker: Tasim
